snippet.title: Jadi Anak Angkat Ruben, Asal Usul Thayaka Putra Onsu Terungkap, Ditemukan Telantar saat Masih Bayi
snippet.description:
Download aplikasi berita TribunX di Play Store atau App Store untuk dapatkan pengalaman baru

TRIBUN-VIDEO.COM - Ruben Onsu kembali mengadopsi anak, kisah awal pertemuannya dengan Thayaka kini terungkap.

Bayi mungil itu kini beranjak balita kini menjadi bagian keluarga sang presenter ternama.

Nama Thayaka dipilih Ruben agar selaras dengan nama kedua putrinya, Thalia dan Thania.

Sahabat Ruben, Melanie Subono mengungkapkan awal mula pertemuan sang presenter dengan Thayaka.

Thayaka ditemukan tim Rumah Harapan saat berusia sekitar dua hingga tiga hari.

Saat ditemukan, kondisi Thayaka memprihatinkan, bahkan tali pusatnya belum benar-benar bersih.

Tim Rumah Harapan kemudian berupaya memberikan pertolongan dan perawatan kepada bayi tersebut.

Saat itu, Ruben sedang berdiskusi mengenai rencana kerja sama dalam program sosial dengan Melanie.

Telepon dari tim Rumah Harapan berkali-kali masuk mengabarkan kondisi bayi yang membutuhkan pertolongan.

Ruben yang mengetahui kabar tersebut kemudian memberikan perhatian kepada bayi itu.

Thayaka akhirnya dibawa ke rumah sakit untuk mendapatkan perawatan yang diperlukan.

Setelah kondisinya pulih, Ruben menyampaikan keinginan mengadopsi bayi tersebut kepada Melanie.

Melanie pun menyetujui keinginan Ruben karena telah mengenal karakter sahabatnya sejak lama.

Meski diasuh Ruben, Melanie mengaku tetap memantau kondisi Thayaka secara berkala.

Ia bahkan menegaskan bisa datang mendadak untuk memastikan Thayaka mendapat pengasuhan yang baik.

Melanie juga siap bertindak jika Thayaka tidak mendapatkan pengasuhan yang semestinya dari Ruben.

Kisah Thayaka ini pun menuai dukungan warganet yang berharap dirinya tumbuh bahagia bersama keluarga Ruben Onsu.

snippet.title: '압도적 승리' 자신하는데...트럼프 지지율 근황 [자막뉴스]  / YTN
snippet.description:
다음 달 3일 중간선거를 앞두고 미국 전역에서는 사전 투표가 진행되고 있습니다.

[나네트 리핀콧 / 미국 미주리주 캔자스시티: 누구에게 투표할지, 무엇에 투표할지 알고 있었습니다.]

snippet.title: Strange Physics Hidden in Nefertitis Face
snippet.description:
Scientific knowledge in plain sight condemned to “mythology” for thousands of years? This is my STUFF.

Sounds ridiculous until you realize we literally do this today.

Turns out, geometry is a pretty effective way to preserve information. Languages disappear, symbols get mistranslated, civilizations collapse, but the laws of physics don’t exactly care who’s running the place.

From the strange proportions of Nefertiti’s bust and the bizarre artwork of Akhenaten’s royal family to the golden ratio, Mie scattering, optical refraction, and the Great Pyramid of Giza, there are some genuinely weird connections worth looking at.

The deeper you go into ancient Egyptian symbolism, sacred geometry, and the physics of light, the stranger these coincidences start to look.

Was Egyptian artwork simply religious symbolism? Or were some of these monuments and artifacts designed to communicate scientific principles across deep time, to people who wouldn’t understand them for thousands of years?

I’m not saying we’ve cracked the code to ancient Egyptian technology. But I am saying there’s a pretty interesting conversation to be had about why certain geometric relationships keep showing up.

Maybe we’ve spent so long trying to translate what the Egyptians said that we forgot to look at what they showed us.

Either way, apparently we’re doing optical physics with 3,000-year-old statues now.

Welcome to the rabbit hole.

snippet.title: Masumlar Apartmanı’nı izleyenler burada mı? Biber Dolması yapıyoruz 🤩
snippet.description:
FIRINDA BİBER DOLMASI 🫑
Malzemeler
 • 6 adet dolmalık biber
İçi için:
 • 1 adet soğan
 •. 1 diş sarımsak
 • 1 adet domates (küçükse 2 adet)
 • 1 yemek kaşığı domates salçası
 • 1 yemek kaşığı biber salçası
 • Yarım çay bardağı zeytinyağı
 • Her biber için küçükse 1, büyükse 2 yemek kaşığı pirinç
 • Tuz, nane, pul biber,sumak,isot
 • 300 ml su
Yapılışı
İç harcı için soğanı ince ince doğrayın. Domateslerin kabuklarını soyup küp küp doğrayın. Salçalar, zeytinyağı, pirinç, baharatlar ve suyu ekleyip güzelce karıştırın.
Dolmalık biberlerin saplarını içe doğru bastırarak çıkarabilir ya da bozulmaması için bıçakla kenarlarından keserek ayırabilirsiniz. Biberleri yıkayıp hazırladığınız iç harçla doldurun.
Biberleri tencereye dizin, üzerlerine ayırdığınız domates kabuklarını kapatın. Biberlerin yarısına gelecek şekilde salçalı su ekleyin. Üzerine yarım çay bardağı zeytinyağı gezdirin.
Ocakta orta ateşte kaynayana kadar pişirin. Kaynadıktan sonra kısık ateşte 20 dakika pişirin.
Ardından 195 derece fırında, üzerleri kızarana kadar yaklaşık 15–20 dakika pişirin.

Afiyet olsun 👩🏻‍🍳

*Gözüken markalar ile reklam/işbirliği bulunmamaktadır.

snippet.title: What Life in North Korea Is Like | Minecraft Animation
snippet.description:
What is life in North Korea like? From space at night most of the country is dark, because the power comes and goes, so families hang small solar panels on their balconies to charge car batteries for the lights and a small TV.

That TV is fixed to the state channels and the radio can't be retuned, so in daily life in North Korea what people really watch is South Korean dramas, smuggled in from China on USB sticks and played on a cheap Chinese player called a notetel. Watching them is a crime under the 2020 Reactionary Ideology and Culture Rejection Act, and special squads such as Group 109 hunt for them. For years their trick was to cut the power to a whole apartment block and then knock on every door, because a disc can't come out of a DVD player with no power. So people switched to USB sticks they can pull out in a second, and some leave a North Korean film in the tray. The city in the video is Hyesan, on the Yalu River across from China; the family and the officer are made up for the story.

Animated in Minecraft.
